QUOTE: `handleChannelDeletedEvent` ... "Channel is archived in place; membership kept" | "If it is the current channel, kick the user out (`Events.CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`); always remove the current user from the channel"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states that when archived channels are not viewable (`"false"`), the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current channel. When viewable, the channel is archived in place, which corresponds to "marked deleted". The `archiveChannel` row also says `delete_at` is set locally, which matches the deleted marking.
